existing_content.what_it_covers: Demonstrating how append-only ledger checkpoints reduce mean-time-to-recovery from tool failure by 84 percent in production workflows.

existing_content.title: Cost and Latency Tradeoffs in Distributed Agent Swarms
existing_content.what_it_covers: Analysis of enterprise agent deployments revealing that unbounded multi-turn loops account for 62 percent of model billing waste without strict budget circuits.

key_takeaways: Single-prompt architectures fail on complex multi-file engineering tasks due to context dilution.
Decoupling memory into short-term working context and long-term append-only ledgers ensures factual fidelity.
Supervisor-worker topologies prevent race conditions by centralizing state validation at gated checkpoints.
Production architectures require hard budget circuits and offline replayability to prevent costly runaway loops.
